title: Bribing commutes with an outside coordinate flip
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, choose a coordinate $i\notin J$, a sign $b$, and an input $x$ in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Flipping coordinate $i$ before bribing the coordinates in $J$ to $b$ gives the same input as bribing first and then flipping coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an input in the $n$-dimensional sign cube
